issues.concern: The gloss includes 'user-friendly (of food)' which is not a direct meaning of 食べやすい. While food can be 'user-friendly' in a broader sense, 食べやすい specifically refers to the ease of eating, not general usability.

The definition gloss includes 'easy to handle (of food)' which is not a direct meaning of 食べやすい. While food can be 'easy to handle' in a broader sense, 食べやすい specifically refers to the ease of eating, not general handling.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'easy to handle (of food)' from the definition gloss.
